intro: one page per package. the rigs are built in code; any model, clip or weight file comes from a url you give or a file you drop, and its licence is shown when it loads.
footer: code mit. pages built from github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-motion. no weights or model files are hosted here.

pages.name: gait
pages.what: procedural dog gait: froude gait choice, leg oscillators, posture springs, tail and ears.

pages.name: ik
pages.what: two bone arm and leg, fabrik and ccd chain, clamped head look at, foot lock on a stepping foot.

pages.name: retarget
pages.what: a bvh walk on another rig, in centimeters, retargeted onto the normalized humanoid. drop your own bvh.

pages.name: motion-net
pages.what: the quadruped codebook matching network (cc by-nc 4.0 weights, fetched from a url you give or read from dropped files, never hosted here) driving a dog of simple shapes: speed, turn, style, foot slide.

pages.name: motion-match
pages.what: motion matching over a synthetic gait clip database with inertialized transitions, following your speed and turn.

pages.name: avatar
pages.what: vrm, glb or fbx into the normalized humanoid: rig mapping, t pose fix, material repair, clips and the first person head hider.

pages.name: avatar-host
pages.what: the stage for any body: the placeholder built in code or a dropped vrm, glb or fbx, a camera that follows the pose, and a loop that stops while the page is hidden, off screen or covered.

pages.name: lipsync
pages.what: visemes from speech word timing (the system voice or timed text), from the bellows voice's phoneme spans or tract model, or from audio level (microphone or a file).

pages.name: organic
pages.what: critically damped springs, inertialization, seeded noise and samplers for procedural animation. rust core in wasm.

pages.name: rig
pages.what: humanoid bone name mapper without per rig tables, limb chains, rest pose analysis, and the expression and viseme table. rust core in wasm.

pages.name: presence
pages.what: procedural presence for humanoids: gaze with saccades and aversion, head recruitment, blink, breath, idle scheduler, pointing, reach, throw, and a layered clip player with loop seams and idle handback.

pages.name: environment
pages.what: brightly lit scenes around a character: layouts as data, a set assembled from kit models and merged by material, image light from an hdri or the three.js room environment, a key light with a shadow and a rim light.

pages.name: bake
pages.what: glb optimize with texture hooks, clip bake into compact packs with error, seam and contact reports, and an asset lock file with licence and sha-256. rust core in wasm, plus a native command line tool.
